topics.description: Recent reports reveal a long history of fraud in Minnesota's human services department, with allegations dating back 50 years. The state's governor has appointed a new commissioner to oversee the department.
topics.reason: New developments in Minnesota fraud case

topics.description: An alleged $1.5M embezzlement from the Fresno Arts Council has led to an investigation and the revelation of the suspect's name.
topics.reason: New details in Fresno Arts Council embezzlement case
